entity_types.name: Product
entity_types.description: Finished furniture product offered in the catalog, distinct from its individual components.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: Individual structural part, piece of hardware, or functional sub-unit of a product, distinct from raw materials.

entity_types.name: Material
entity_types.description: Raw material, substance, or fabric from which a product or component is made, distinct from fabricated parts.

entity_types.name: QualityAspect
entity_types.description: Functional, physical, or experiential characteristic, performance property, or defect evaluated in an item.

fact_types.description: Associates a named component directly with the product it belongs to as established by the document context.
Specifies the raw material or substance of which a component is constructed.
Specifies the primary material or composition from which a finished product is fabricated.
Describes a mechanical fastening, alignment, or physical interface between two components.
Records physical dimensions, overall weight, assembly duration, or capacity metrics for a finished product.
Records technical specifications, dimensions, tolerances, load ratings, or power values of a component.
Records an observed quality, functional behavior, defect, or assembly experience of a product, with claim polarity capturing sentiment.
Records an observed quality, flaw, or performance characteristic of an individual component, with claim polarity indicating positive or negative outcome.
